title: Arrow of Transposition

sources.title: Arrow of Transposition
markers: * Teleport wherever you fire this arrow.

summary: Teleports you to the point you shoot. Uses the entire Action, including when you have Extra Attack. It preserves Hiding and ends Invisibility.

fields.Activation: Action. Fire from a ranged weapon and consume one arrow. Range 60 ft.
fields.Effect: Teleports you to the point you shoot. Uses the entire Action, including when you have Extra Attack. It preserves Hiding and ends Invisibility.
fields.Restrictions: Special arrows cannot be used with off-hand ranged attacks.
fields.Crafting: Special arrows are obtained from loot or vendors.
fields.Creative use: Cross a gap or reposition while hiding.
fields.Base value: 50 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 activation, effects and linked rules.
